issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class 'Ride': the problem statement and UML require a public constructor Ride(String name, char abbreviation) (problem_statement.md: constructor rule and UML Ride attributes), but the solution implementation defines only Ride(String name). Meanwhile, solution's RollerCoaster and LaunchedRollerCoaster constructors call super(name, abbreviation) and super(name, abbreviation, numberOfLoopings) which assume a two-parameter Ride constructor. This inconsistency causes compilation failure and prevents students from following the specified constructor parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a public constructor to Ride with the signature Ride(String name, char abbreviation) that assigns both fields in that order. Ensure RollerCoaster calls super(name, abbreviation) and subclasses continue to call their super constructors so compilation matches the UML and the problem's constructor-order requirement.
